title: Many more written people for the understanding students, the truth the code's and every request kept whole
request: The owner: 'the student model must have more ability', with $15 to test and fix (plan 2026-10-25 Part B1).
spec: 600 homework people over the 15 replica kinds through the gateway (Claude only), each with its declared truth; a checker that keeps apart a person who does not fit; a sealed set written apart by another writer; played on the rules with whole records.
plan: Read why the understanding students failed.
Let the code, not the writer, own the truth.
Ask for variety by businesses, knowledge, mistakes and answers.
A second request checks each person.
Keep every request and reply whole; resumable; capped.

decisions.decision: The writer writes only the first words and the answers; the kind and family come from the code.
decisions.why: A writer that also declared the truth could mislabel; the checker catches people whose words describe another problem.

decisions.decision: The businesses are suggestions, taken only where a business like it could have the table.
decisions.why: The first request gave a delivery-fraud table 'a recruitment firm' and 'a farm cooperative': people forced into them would not fit and would be paid for and set aside.

decisions.decision: The homework writer goes through the gateway; the sealed people are written by a fresh agent apart.
decisions.why: The gateway keeps every request and reply whole for the models; two different writers keep the exam apart from the homework's style.

decisions.decision: Two purposes with no user data (journey_writer, journey_checker), in the data-limit test's no_user_data set.
decisions.why: They see invented replica tables' column names and written people only, never a workspace's data.

change: dclab_rnd/people_writer.py (new), dclab_rnd/prompts/journey_writer.md and journey_checker.md (new), dclab_rnd/models/settings.py and dclab_rnd/agents/harness.py (the purposes), tests/test_people_writer.py (new), tests/test_model_data_limits.py; make agent-eval (AEV-058) and make harness-eval (HRN-043) after the prompt change.

findings.defect: The understanding students' homework was too small and too easy.
findings.scenario: problem.family: 236 rows from 118 people, the rule right on 95%; its sealed exam 11 decisions.
findings.cause: Journeys were written by hand or once per kind for the replicas' tests.
findings.test: the rule's accuracy on them is reported before any training

findings.defect: A student on the ledger's state cannot read the person's words.
findings.scenario: The workflow gate's own note: problem.family 0.526 against the rules' 0.895, the recorded state holds no words.
findings.cause: States never hold a person's words.
findings.fix: B2 adds a student that reads the written people's words (invented, allowed), beside the rule and the state-only one.

findings.defect: Businesses that cannot have the table were forced on the writer.
findings.scenario: A delivery-fraud table with 'a recruitment firm'.
findings.cause: A fixed draw from one pool for every kind.
findings.test: the request printed by plan before any spend

findings.defect: A reply with broken JSON lost its whole batch.
findings.scenario: The first live batch held a stray closing brace after one person's answers: the parser read one inner object and returned no people.
findings.cause: The parser read the first object only.
findings.fix: Each person's object read on its own (raw_decode at each '{"words"'); the kept reply re-parsed, no new request.

findings.defect: The checker set aside exactly the hard cases the homework is for.
findings.scenario: 'Need clustering of our subscribers into leavers and stayers' on the churn table: flagged as not fitting, though the goal is churn.
findings.cause: The checker judged the technique's name, not the goal.
findings.fix: The checker prompt says to judge the goal; recheck asks the new checker again on kept batches, the old checks kept beside.
findings.test: the same test; AEV-059 and HRN-044 ran on the new prompt

findings.defect: The lake's answer sets would read the new sealed people.
findings.scenario: lake/answers.py reads every journeys_*.json as problem.family_from_words tests, most of a set in its train share.
findings.fix: journeys_understand_sealed.json skipped until its gate has read it; the homework people in the one split they have everywhere.

measurements.name: scripted suites after the prompt change
measurements.gate: make agent-eval and make harness-eval (no model)
measurements.result: harness 17 of 17 right on every step and part; the agent suite's scripted policies as before; the prompt and harness gates pass
limits: the first pair of suite results, on the prompt before its business fix, was removed before it was committed instead of being kept

measurements.name: the first live batches
measurements.gate: a trial capped at EUR 0.3 on one kind
measurements.result: 4 batches, EUR 0.1237: 30 people parsed (40 after the parser fix), 4 set aside by the first checker; about EUR 0.03 a batch

outcome: The writer is ready to run; its live run and the people it writes follow.
lessons: Print a live request before paying for it: the business list's misfit showed only in the real request.
risks: Students may learn the writer's style: the sealed set's separate writer and the rule-accuracy check are the defences.
